config.ars_arcane_matrix.recipes.enableB: Enabled by default. Controls the Matrix budding amethyst apparatus recipe, not the golem's own conversion. Restart after changing.
config.ars_arcane_matrix.recipes.enableC: Enabled by default. Controls stonecutting for Drygmy, Whirlisprig, Starbuncle, Wixie and Alakarkinos tokens. Restart after changing.

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.storage_: The Grid Directory stores large quantities of items. A Bookwyrm can connect it to a Storage Lectern, and pipes or automation can access it. Base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items, with up to four expansion upgrades. Breaking it preserves its inventory and upgrades in the dropped item.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.category.descript: Core structures, devices, and upgrades from Ars Arcane Matrix.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.overv: The Arcane Matrix Core is a late-game Source generator unlocked by completing the mineral-processing line. Its recipe requires all five Sourcelinks plus the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher crystals. Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Arcane Structural Frame around it. It starts when at least one ring is complete; other rings may be expanded block by block, while six axial Arcane Amplifiers add 25% generation each.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.overv: Build consecutive 3, 5, 7, and 9-wide inverted-beacon layers above the Arcane Mine Core. The first layer uses five Source Gem Blocks at its center and corners, with four Sourcestone blocks at the cardinal edges. Later layers use Arcane Structural Frames. The four layers unlock wood-, stone-, iron-, and diamond-tier ores. The Mine does not buffer Source and only runs when it can pay the full operation cost. Four layers expand Source reach to 32 blocks. Gem-block corners hold whitelist samples; Sourcestone edge centers hold blacklist samples. Late rare ores require layer four.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.cycle: Produce Lapis Ore, process it with Fortune or an Arcane Processor, and send Lapis Blocks to the Arcane Imbuement Core. Return enough Source Gems to the mine's material container to keep it supplied. Both machines need Source, but neither requires a Matrix Core.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.ampli: A complete four-layer Mine gains one 1% Amplifier roll for every 128 material points consumed and guarantees one after 12,800 points. Install one at each layer center to add one ordinary ore while raising Source and material costs by 50%. The core buffers up to 64 Amplifiers; surplus ones can be imbued for recycling.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_c: The Arcane Matrix Core produces large amounts of Source after the mineral processing line is complete. Its recipe requires five Sourcelinks and all three processing crystals. Complete at least one 5x5 frame ring to start it; additional valid frames and Amplifiers increase production.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_m: The Arcane Mine consumes materials and Source to produce ores. Its four layers unlock wood, stone, iron, and diamond mining tiers, with shorter default intervals at higher layers. Use a whitelist to select wanted ores or a blacklist to exclude unwanted ones.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_a: The Arcane Amplifier is a rare byproduct of a complete four-layer Arcane Mine. Every 128 material points consumed are equivalent to one 1% roll, with a guarantee after 12,800 points without success; cheap minerals do not receive equal roll efficiency. In a Matrix, replace up to six axial Source Gem Block vertices; each adds 25% of base Source generation. In a Mine, replace one center Source Gem Block per completed layer; each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_i: The Arcane Imbuement Core is a standalone bulk Source Gem converter and no longer requires an Imbuement Chamber. Bind output and input inventories in that order with a Dominion Wand. It pulls nearby Source and processes up to four inputs every five seconds by default. Lapis Lazuli and Amethyst Shards each cost 500 Source and yield one Source Gem; Lapis Blocks yield nine and Amethyst Blocks yield four. Compact mode converts every four Gems into a Source Gem Block. Surplus Arcane Amplifiers can also be recycled. Redstone pauses processing.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_s: The Source Stone Generator produces stone and soil in bulk. With no matching pedestal setup, it makes 64 Cobblestone and works slowly even without Source. Available Source within the surrounding 3×3×3 area makes each batch take five seconds. Non-empty pedestals in that area select the product without consuming their items. Results enter an inventory below or can be extracted from any face. Redstone pauses operation.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.source_stone_gene: The Source Stone Generator makes 64 Cobblestone when no pedestal recipe matches. It works slowly without Source; available Source within the surrounding 3×3×3 area makes each batch take five seconds. Non-empty pedestals in that area select the product without consuming their items. Results enter a container below or can be extracted from any face. Redstone pauses operation.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_a: The Arcane Hunting Grounds creates the unique drop of the boss stored in its Mob Jar. Hearts of the Sea, Echo Shards, smithing templates, and Dragon Heads come from Alakarkinos exploration instead. The Grounds consumes no Source, creates no entity, causes no death event, produces no experience, and creates no ordinary drops.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.over: Place one Mob Jar directly above the Arcane Hunting Grounds and at least two Arcane Pedestals within two blocks horizontally. Pedestals draw catalysts from nearby inventories: Conjuration Essence supplies 10 points and a Condensed Summoning Core supplies 100. The stored creature only selects the target and is never spawned or harmed.
ars_arcane_matrix.glyph_desc.glyph_captu: Captures a touched non-boss creature into an empty Containment Jar in the caster's inventory. Amplify switches the glyph to boss-only capture mode.

book.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.auto: The Grounds creates a stored boss's unique material, such as a Nether Star, Wilden Tribute, or Dragon Egg. It produces no ordinary loot, experience, death sounds, or Wither Roses. Once enough catalyst points are available, a cycle takes five minutes by default. Results enter adjacent inventories and redstone pauses operation.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_: The Arcane Imbuement Core is a standalone bulk converter. It does not require an Imbuement Chamber and does not improve ordinary imbuement recipes; the Advanced Imbuement Chamber is a separate device. Use a Dominion Wand to bind output first and input second; sneak-use clears both bindings. The Core draws nearby Source, and redstone pauses processing.

Up to four inputs finish every five seconds. Lapis or an Amethyst Shard costs 500 Source for one Source Gem; a Lapis Block costs 4,500 for nine; an Amethyst Block costs 2,000 for four. An Amplifier costs 2,000 and recycles into sixteen. Empty-hand use switches between loose and compact output.
A complete four-layer Arcane Mine gains one 1% Amplifier roll for every 128 material points consumed and guarantees one after 12,800 points. Progress resets after a success. If output is blocked, the Mine stores up to 64 Amplifiers.
Arcane Matrix: Replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of base generation, up to a total bonus of 150%.

Arcane Mine: Place one at the center of each complete layer, up to four. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%; four give 5x output at 3x cost. Recycle surplus Amplifiers in an Imbuement Chamber or Arcane Imbuement Core.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.info: Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Arcane Structural Frame around the core. It generates Source when at least one ring is complete; other rings may be expanded block by block. Build the Matrix before scaling the Mine and mineral-processing line.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.amplif: Any of the six axial vertices may be replaced with an Arcane Amplifier. Each adds 25% of base generation, for a total bonus of 150%.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.i: The 3x3 first layer needs five Source Gem Blocks at its center/corners and four Sourcestone blocks at its cardinal edges—no alloy. From layer two onward, keep those gem and Sourcestone markers but fill every other position with Arcane Structural Frames. Consecutive 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, and 9x9 layers unlock wood, stone, iron, and diamond mining tiers.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.t: Source Gem Block corners are whitelist markers: hang ore samples beneath them. Sourcestone blocks at the north, south, east, and west centers are blacklist markers. The blacklist always excludes afterward; duplicate samples add no weight and incomplete-layer samples do nothing.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.a: One Arcane Amplifier may occupy each completed layer center, up to four. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%. At full amplification, ordinary output is 5x and costs are 3x. In a complete four-layer Mine, every 128 material points consumed equal one 1% Amplifier roll, with a guarantee at 12,800 points.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.i: A rare full-mine byproduct rolled from actual material consumption: every 128 material points equal one 1% roll, guaranteed at 12,800 points.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.m: In an Arcane Matrix: replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of base Source generation, up to six for a total bonus of 150%.

In an Arcane Mine: place at most one in the center of each completed layer. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. The byproduct amount stays at one; the higher actual material cost advances its roll and pity proportionally.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.r: Recycling: an ordinary Imbuement Chamber converts one Arcane Amplifier into four Source Gem Blocks for 2,000 Source. The Arcane Imbuement Core can instead output sixteen Source Gems or four Source Gem Blocks according to its mode.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_c: A standalone bulk Source Gem converter that requires no Imbuement Chamber. It accepts Lapis Lazuli, Amethyst Shards, their storage blocks, and Arcane Amplifiers.
Lapis: one Lapis Lazuli costs 500 Source and produces one Source Gem; a Lapis Block costs 4,500 Source and produces nine. Up to four inputs are processed together in five seconds by default.

Amethyst: one Shard costs 500 Source and produces one Source Gem; an Amethyst Block costs 2,000 Source and produces four. Compact mode waits for four Gems before exporting a Source Gem Block. Each Arcane Amplifier costs 2,000 Source and recycles into sixteen Gems or four Gem Blocks.

The Core pulls up to 100,000 Source per second by default. Use a Dominion Wand to bind output first and input second; sneak-use clears both. Up to four inputs finish together in five seconds by default. Redstone pauses processing.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.source_stone_gener: A compact generator for bulk stone and soil production. With no matching pedestal setup, it produces 64 Cobblestone after 200 progress and gains 20 progress per second even without Source.

It reads every non-empty Arcane Pedestal in a 3x3x3 area centered on the generator. Items are matched unordered and exactly and are not consumed. Only Source providers in that area can power it; with Source, every batch takes a fixed five seconds.
The nine-slot buffer pushes into the inventory directly below. Pipes may extract from every face. A blocked output stops progress and Source use; redstone pauses operation.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.info: Place a Mob Jar directly above the Arcane Hunting Grounds and at least two Arcane Pedestals anywhere in its nearby detection volume. Conjuration Essence is worth 10 points and a Condensed Summoning Core is worth 100.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.drops: Creates the unique drop of the boss stored in the Mob Jar. Structure loot comes from Alakarkinos exploration and ordinary drops from Drygmy Henges. The Grounds never creates or kills entities, causes death events, plays boss sounds, or awards experience.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.autom: After the configured target cost is paid, one cycle takes five minutes by default. Outputs are pushed into adjacent inventories and may be extracted from every side. Redstone pauses operation.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting_guide.inf: First open a Wixie Order Terminal or the crafting page of an Advanced Storage Lectern. Then view an ordinary crafting recipe in JEI and press its transfer button to consume one blank guide and encode that recipe. Encoding is unavailable from the normal inventory screen. The off-hand sample and Crafting Table method remains available, but JEI is unambiguous when an output has multiple recipes.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting_guide.fuz: Tag Preference chooses an available material allowed by the recipe. Strict Recipe always uses the preferred material shown by the recipe. Sneak-right-click a recorded guide to switch modes. Materials with enchantments, durability, or special data default to Strict Recipe.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: The Wixie Order Terminal, Order Pedestal, and Pattern Provider handle crafting. The Storage Lectern and Bookwyrm handle storage. The Advanced Storage Lectern combines them. Crafting Guides record recipes, while the Automatic Stock Requester replenishes low stock. See each device entry for instructions.
The Order Terminal selects an output, calculates its materials, and sends a virtual request to the Wixie network.

Enchanted Crystals are produced only by the Arcane Processor. Supply its food inventory with Ars Nouveau magical food to enable magical-food mode; ordinary food never produces crystals.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.inf: Processes minerals in #c:ores, #c:raw_materials, and #c:dusts that have furnace recipes, plus vanilla raw metal blocks. It smelts a mixed batch of up to 64 items every five seconds; dust yield is determined by its recipe.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.str: Empty-hand right-click the core to preview the 3x3x2 structure. Leave the block above the core empty as the furnace mouth and place any inventory-capable container above it for fuel; the preview uses a Chest.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.aut: The Dominion Wand's first connection binds output and its second binds input. Redstone pauses the machine. Lava buckets return their empty buckets.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.enchanted_archwood: Crafted from one Enchanted Crystal and eight Archwood logs. It powers 128 Arcane Smelter operations and enables Casting Crystal byproducts. Once the Crusher stage can sustain Fire Essence production, combine four Enchanted Archwood Charcoal, four Fire Essence, one bucket of lava, and 2,000 Source in an Arcane Reaction Vessel to make a block with ten times one charcoal's burn duration, replacing part of the Archwood demand with the essence line. Inserting either enchanted fuel immediately replaces unfinished ordinary fuel.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.casting_crystal.so: Casting Crystals are produced only by an Arcane Smelter fueled with Enchanted Archwood Charcoal and gate the next Crusher stage.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.casting_crystal.pi: Enchanted fuel mode rolls a 12.5% chance for every 16 minerals processed. The eighth roll after seven failures is guaranteed, so one appears after at most 128 minerals.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_s: The Arcane Smelter is the second stage of the mineral-processing line. It uses vanilla furnace fuels to process mixed batches of ores, raw minerals, raw metal blocks, and dusts, totaling up to 64 every five seconds. Build a 3×3×3 shell with the core at the center of its front face, a fuel container below it, and 24 structural frames around them. Interior gaps are not checked. Enchanted Archwood Charcoal enables Casting Crystal byproducts. Buckets and other crafting remainders return to the fuel container when possible, otherwise to the output buffer. Bind input and output with a Dominion Wand, and empty-hand right-click the core to preview its structure.
jade.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.diver: Ecological diversity: %s/5 · about %s work actions per cycle
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.earth_: Earth Essence is drawn from an ordinary inventory within three blocks. This mode keeps Archwood-related output, quadruples the whole cycle, and gains speed from nearby plant families.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.advanc: Ancient Grove Catalyst is drawn from an ordinary inventory within three blocks. This mode keeps only Archwood logs, multiplies the whole cycle by eight, and gains speed from nearby plant families.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.consum: A catalyst is consumed only after Source is paid and production begins. Logs, leaves, and saplings of one plant count as one family, up to five. Diversity levels 1 through 5 take about 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 work actions per cycle.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.burn_sherd.bootstr: Use a Brick, Earth Essence, 250 mB of Lava, and 500 Source in the Arcane Reaction Vessel to make a Burn Pottery Sherd. Give an appropriate sherd to an Alakarkinos for native work or expeditions.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisp: The Whirlisprig draws Earth Essence or Ancient Grove Catalyst from ordinary inventories within three blocks; without a catalyst, native behavior is unchanged. Both grove modes read ecological diversity within five blocks. Logs, leaves, and saplings of one plant count as one family, up to five. Diversity levels 1 through 5 take about 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 work actions per cycle.

Keep the Whirlisprig near the grove center and place an Earth Essence inventory within three blocks. Mix Archwood, flowers, crops, berries, or ancient plants nearby; output filtering removes unwanted products. Each successful cycle consumes one essence and quadruples Archwood-related output. Diversity 5 completes a cycle in about one work action.

Ancient Grove mode uses the same ecological layout; replace Earth Essence with Ancient Grove Catalyst. Each successful cycle consumes one catalyst, keeps only Archwood logs, and multiplies the whole cycle by eight. Ecological diversity affects speed only and does not multiply output again.

Whirlisprig groves primarily serve the Archwood chain. Special modes already filter output, so different Archwood species and a few representative plants can share a compact grove. Repeating one family does not add speed. Bulk ordinary crops should still use Ars Nouveau growth and harvest systems.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.advanced_imbuement: The Advanced Imbuement Chamber uses the ordinary chamber's recipes, pedestal matching, automation, and rotating model, and appears in the same JEI Imbuement category. With external Source it draws up to 2,000 Source per second and reduces recipe preparation to one second.

Without an external Source provider it retains Ars Nouveau's slow 10 Source per second passive accumulation and does not scale that free progress. High-speed operation therefore requires Source infrastructure. Ordinary chambers remain unchanged.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.formless_essence.i: Around an ordinary or Advanced Imbuement Chamber, place all seven native Essences and one Wilden Tribute on eight pedestals. Imbue an Amethyst Cluster with 2,000 Source to produce four Formless Essences. Pedestal items are catalytic and are not consumed.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.formless_essence.c: Shapelessly combine Formless Essence with an available Essence to produce two of that Essence. All seven native Essences and compatible Essences from installed add-ons are supported.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.advanced: The Advanced Imbuement Chamber speeds up ordinary imbuement while keeping the same recipes and surrounding pedestal requirements. It becomes available at the Arcane Smelter stage, before the Crusher, and helps supply essences for crushing.

The Formless Essence recipe works in either an ordinary or Advanced Imbuement Chamber. Put all seven native Essences and one Wilden Tribute on eight surrounding pedestals, then imbue an Amethyst Cluster with 2,000 Source to produce four Formless Essences. Pedestal catalysts are not consumed. Shapeless conversion supports every native Essence.
ars_arcane_matrix.ritual_desc.rare_creat: Consumes one Source Jar and summons a Breeze. Reinforced Deepslate, Prismarine Bricks, Gilded Blackstone, and Purpur select a Warden, Elder Guardian, Piglin Brute, and Shulker. Each activation summons one sample and ends.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.inf: Every five seconds, the Crusher consumes one Essence from the upper structure container to process a mixed batch of up to 16 minerals. Raw minerals yield two dust by default and ore blocks yield one; Air Essence raises these to three and two respectively.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.com: Automatically recognizes metal ores and raw minerals and finds a compatible dust. Iron, copper, gold prefer this mod's dusts. Redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, and Amethyst Clusters are excluded. Ancient Debris uses a special recipe and receives the normal ore-block Air Essence yield bonus.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.aut: The Dominion Wand's first connection binds output and its second binds input. Empty-hand right-click previews the 5x3x2 grinding frame. Any inventory-capable container may replace the preview Chest and supply Essence; redstone pauses operation.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.enriched_mineral_c: Water Essence mode makes a 12.5% roll for every 16 minerals processed. The eighth roll after seven failures is guaranteed to produce an Enriched Mineral Crystal.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_c: The Arcane Crusher is the third mineral-processing stage. It discovers metal dusts through common tags and consumes one Essence every five seconds to process a mixed batch totaling up to 16 items. Its 5×4×5 structure uses 33 frames to form a lower 3×3 bed, a middle 5×5 rim, and an upper 3×3 crushing plate. The core replaces the front-center frame, with the Essence container directly below it; all other positions are ignored. Air Essence increases dust yield, while Water Essence keeps the base yield and enables Enriched Mineral Crystal byproducts. Bind input and output with a Dominion Wand, and empty-hand right-click the core to preview its structure.

Sneak-right-click a core: complete as much of the structure as possible
In Creative, right-click builds everything without materials

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.amethyst: Amethyst Golems rotate between Amethyst Blocks and Budding Amethyst within ten blocks of their home and keep their progress after a restart. Multiple golems try to choose different targets, but may share scarce targets, so adding golems still increases total output. Place a pickaxe on a pedestal to enhance their work without damaging the tool: Efficiency speeds growth and harvesting, Fortune improves shard drops, and Silk Touch harvests intact clusters. Enhanced output enters the home inventory or drops safely nearby when full.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.amethyst_golem_enh: Place a pickaxe on an Arcane Pedestal within ten blocks of home. Efficiency shortens growth and harvest cooldowns and actions, and gives every Budding Amethyst one plus the Efficiency level growth attempts. Efficiency V uses a one-second action and six attempts per block. Conversion keeps its five-minute cooldown. Fortune increases drops and Silk Touch yields intact Clusters. The tool is never damaged; its simulated-tool mode automatically routes products to the home inventory, leaving overflow in the world.

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.starbunc: Add tamed Starbuncles within 32 blocks with a Dominion Wand or the menu scan. The hub keeps their visible routes while accelerating container transfers up to its tier's shared rate. Each worker has its own 27-slot filter and matching settings. Invalid routes may be recalled manually or automatically, with charms and undelivered items entering the 18-slot maintenance buffer.

tooltip.ars_arcane_matrix.integrated_sou: On-demand access to the linked Source network
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_n: Place the Matrix Source Reservoir Core at the midpoint of any lower outer edge of a hollow 7×7×7 structure. Fill the top and bottom with Arcane Structural Frames and the five middle walls with Tinted Glass; the interior may contain a Matrix or other blocks. Once formed, it stores 100,000,000 Source and gathers from producers within 24 blocks: up to 20,000 from each and 1,000,000 total per second. Matrix Cores may also push Source directly into it. It does not drain machines or other jars. Integrated Source Relays supply devices; cross-dimensional links require an Advanced Storage Lectern and loaded remote chunks.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.dimensio: The Dimensional Anchor draws 100 Source per second from providers within 8 blocks, keeping its own chunk loaded and running. Surround it at the same height with eight Arcane Structural Frames to enable expansion mode, which loads a centered 3×3 chunk area for 900 Source per second. If Source runs out, a redstone signal is received, the expansion frame changes, or the anchor is broken, it immediately unloads chunks it no longer maintains. Empty-hand right-click previews the expansion structure, and the Matrix Construction Wand places missing frames. Cross-dimensional Source and storage networks require their remote nodes to remain loaded.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarkinos_expedi: Route proof: placed on another Arcane Pedestal near the home and not consumed

Place a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal within three blocks of an Alakarkinos home to enable container exploration. It only extracts blocks from nearby inventories and never breaks placed blocks; the home receives rewards.
Sand and gravel use Ars Nouveau's archaeology rewards. Other blocks represent different exploration destinations. When a route needs a key or other proof, place it on another nearby pedestal.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarki: With a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal near its home, an Alakarkinos consumes exploration blocks from nearby inventories and returns rewards. Sand and gravel retain Ars Nouveau's archaeology rewards, while other blocks represent different destinations. This mode never breaks placed world blocks.

Tame an Alakarkinos normally, give it a pottery sherd to wear, and bind a container as its home. Put a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal within three blocks and place exploration blocks in inventories within the same range. The home receives rewards. Nothing is charged early when materials, Source, or output space are insufficient.

Cobblestone, dirt, sculk, netherrack with blackstone, end stone, and tuff simulate chests from different destinations; JEI shows only example rewards. Rewards added to those chests by other mods may also appear. Ancient City sculk can be produced by the Source Stone Generator. Trial routes also read a nearby Trial Key or Ominous Trial Key.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.capture_: A portable containment option found in the tier-three glyph catalog that places a touched creature directly into an empty Containment Jar in the inventory.

Learn the tier-three Capture glyph at the Scribe's Table and carry empty Containment Jars. Normal mode captures non-bosses; Amplify switches to bosses only. Riding stacks are captured from the top passenger down. Keep inventory space available. Containment rules may forbid some creatures.
After obtaining your first Source Gems, build a Sourcelink and Source Jar, then use the Reaction Vessel and Source Stone Generator to supply materials. The Arcane Processor can process ores you mine by hand; it does not require an Arcane Mine. Build the mine once materials and Source are ready.

The Processor produces Enchanted Crystals for the Smelter. The Smelter produces Casting Crystals for the Crusher. The Advanced Imbuement Chamber is available during the smelting stage. Enriched Mineral Crystals from crushing unlock the Matrix Core and later devices. Check recipes for exact requirements.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.construc: Right-click a multiblock core with an empty hand to preview missing blocks. Right-click with the Matrix Construction Wand to place one block; sneak-right-click to place as many as possible. Creative mode needs no materials. Remove obstructing blocks yourself; the wand never breaks them.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.multiblo: Use an empty hand on the core to preview missing blocks. The Matrix Construction Wand places one missing block, or as many as possible when sneak-used. In Creative mode it needs no materials.

Supply consumables in the structure's ordinary container and tools on an Arcane Pedestal. Previews and the construction wand use barrels to demonstrate container positions; other compatible containers also work. Unspecified spaces need not stay empty and may hold levers, lights, or pipes.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_p: The Processor is the first ore-processing stage. It accepts intact ore blocks and simulates the tool on its pedestal. It processes up to five ores in parallel. Food supplies runtime, while magical food immediately switches it into a special mode that advances the Enchanted Crystal byproduct.

Bind ore input and product output containers with the Dominion Wand. The container below the core supplies food. Five frames above form a cross, with the tool pedestal above its center. Right-click empty-handed for a preview. Redstone pauses processing; blocked outputs remain buffered in the core.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_e: A Drygmy Henge reads weapons on nearby Arcane Pedestals as simulated kill tools. Sharpness improves speed, Looting increases rewards, and beheading effects can participate in the simulated kill. Only targets worth substantial experience produce noticeable experience gems.
Pedestal weapons are not consumed. The Henge also has improved per-operation Source transfer and clearly reports when Source is missing.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.stock_re: The Automatic Stock Requester monitors one item in a linked target container. When stock falls below its threshold, it submits one configured order to a linked Wixie Order Terminal and consumes one Manipulation Essence from linked storage.

Open the GUI empty-handed. Pick up a sample with the cursor and click the target slot to set it without consuming the sample. Right-click that slot or use the clear button to remove it. Set the stock threshold and order amount, then bind the target container and a terminal or Advanced Storage Lectern.
The Advanced Storage Lectern searches linked containers and Storage Grid Directories and provides a collapsible 3x3 crafting area. Bookwyrms establish storage links; the lectern browses and manipulates the network instead of requiring Bookwyrms to physically carry every item.

Grid Directories excel at storing many copies of relatively few items. Base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items. Up to four Grid Expansion Warehouses may be installed; each adds 64 types and 262,144 items. Equipment with different enchantments, durability, or affixes consumes separate types and is better kept in ordinary storage. Breaking the directory preserves its inventory and upgrades.

The lectern supports search, sorting, scrolling, a collapsible crafting area, and JEI uses/recipes for virtual items. It can also bridge cross-dimensional storage and Source networks. Remote nodes must remain chunk-loaded through a Dimensional Anchor or equivalent.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.logistic: The Starbuncle Logistics Hub manages registered Starbuncles, increases endgame transfer throughput, and shows each Starbuncle's input, output, and target container. Filters, match modes, and current selection are saved per Starbuncle.

Each Starbuncle has an independent 27-slot virtual filter with allowlist, denylist, and matching modes. The hub can recall invalid-route or all Starbuncles and protects registered workers from transport hazards, pushing, and prolonged jams. Filter samples are never consumed.

All routes share one maximum transfer rate: 256 items/s at base, then 1,024, 4,096, and 16,384 through the Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched upgrades, reaching 32,768 items/s with the grid-stage upgrade. Ordinary pickup preserves the tier, managed Starbuncles, and filters. After an Enchanting Apparatus upgrade, scan the Starbuncles again. Items in the 18-slot buffer drop when broken.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_n: The Arcane Source Jar is a pre-Mine 1,000,000-Source buffer that actively gathers nearby Sourcelink output and directly supplies machines. The Matrix Source Reservoir is its post-processing multiblock upgrade and does nothing while incomplete. Integrated Source Relays supply linked devices, Advanced Storage Lecterns bridge dimensions, and Dimensional Anchors keep remote chunks loaded.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.integrat: The Integrated Source Relay is the machine-facing output of a large Source network. It draws from a bound Matrix Core, completed Matrix Source Reservoir, or Advanced Storage Lectern and exposes that Source through an Ars Nouveau-compatible provider for nearby machines. Its early recipe uses four ordinary relays and a Source Gem Block; after unlocking the Crusher, four Enriched Mineral Crystals provide an alternative recipe.

Click the Integrated Source Relay and its Source node with the Dominion Wand in either order to bind them. Sneak-right-click to clear the link. The relay draws directly from its network without filling a local buffer. Cross-dimensional use requires an Advanced Storage Lectern and loaded remote chunks.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.troubles: When a machine does not work, check structure completion, redstone power, available Source, input/output links, output capacity, and whether the item has a supported recipe. Inspect projections with an empty hand, read Jade status, and confirm recipes and modes in JEI.

Dominion Wand interaction takes priority over empty-hand interaction. Truly empty your hand to switch modes; hold the wand and click in the documented order to create links. If a container rejects an untyped input, seed it with one target item or inspect its face and filter configuration.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: Prepare one Wixie workstation with a summoned Wixie, an Arcane Order Pedestal, Pattern Provider, Order Terminal, at least one encoded Crafting Guide, and Dominion-bound shared input and output containers. The workstation and pedestal must be within network range. Sneak-use a device with an empty hand to display that range.

Use the JEI transfer button to record a Crafting Table recipe in a blank Crafting Guide, then store it in the Pattern Provider. Select an output and quantity in the terminal. The network automatically plans required intermediates while multiple Wixies work in parallel. Intermediates must return to shared input storage and final products enter the bound output. The terminal lists missing materials.
New players should begin here for device order, material loops, and multiblock construction.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisp: Enable grove mode with Earth Essence or Ancient Grove Catalyst in an inventory, then gain speed from nearby plant diversity; without a catalyst, native behavior remains unchanged.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarki: Alakarkinos consume bulk terrain and metal blocks to simulate vanilla structure chests.
The Advanced Storage Lectern unifies linked inventories, grid directories, and autocrafting access.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.troubles: When a device stops, check structure, redstone, Source, links, output space, and recipe support first.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.order_pe: The Order Pedestal marks a virtual crafting task sent by the terminal; players never place or retrieve output samples on it.

Place the Order Pedestal within the Wixie crafting network's range. After an order is placed, it displays the current virtual task and awaited materials. Wixies still draw real ingredients from Dominion-bound shared input containers and deliver final products through workstation output links. No finished-product container is required beneath the pedestal.

A base pedestal dispatches every 0.5 seconds and permits one parallel job. Upgrade it as an Enchanting Apparatus reagent through gold, diamond, and netherite blocks, using Manipulation Essence, the matching stage crystal, and 1, 2, then 4 Sourcebound Copper Alloy. The tiers permit 2, 4, then all available Wixies in parallel; the final tier dispatches every 0.05 seconds. Upgrades never shorten a workstation's real processing time.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: A Crafting Guide stores one ordinary Crafting Table recipe for Pattern Providers and order planning. Inverse 1-to-4/9 single-material compression recipes are treated as storage operations and consume no Source.

First open a Wixie Order Terminal or the crafting page of an Advanced Storage Lectern, then open the desired Crafting Table recipe in JEI and press its transfer plus button while carrying a blank guide. Encoding is unavailable from the normal inventory screen. Alternatively, hold the output sample offhand and use a blank guide on a Crafting Table. Craft an encoded guide by itself in a shapeless grid to clear it back into a blank guide.

Sneak-right-click a recorded guide to switch between tag-preferred and strict matching. Tag-preferred matching may use compatible materials; strict matching follows the recorded requirements. Its inventory icon shows the result, while its held appearance remains parchment.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.pattern_: The Pattern Provider stores Crafting Guides and exposes their recipes to nearby Order Terminals and Wixie workstations.

Place encoded guides in its GUI. The provider discovers workstations with summoned Wixies inside its range; sneak-use it with an empty hand to display that range. Wixies use Dominion-bound shared input and output containers—the provider is not an ingredient inventory. One provider can serve several workstations participating in parallel orders.

A base provider stores 27 guides. Upgrade it as an Enchanting Apparatus reagent through gold, diamond, and netherite blocks, using the matching stage crystal, Manipulation Essence, and 1, 2, then 4 Sourcebound Copper Alloy to reach 54, 81, and 108 slots. Existing guides are preserved.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.grid_dir: The Storage Grid Directory uses a Repository Controller as its index core, then folds warehouse space through four Arcane Structural Frames and Enriched Mineral Crystals. It exposes compact storage to lecterns, Bookwyrms, pipes, and automation.

Base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items. Its menu directly accepts and returns items and has slots for up to four Grid Expansion Warehouses. Once linked, an Advanced Storage Lectern can search, withdraw, and autocraft from it. Breaking the directory preserves its inventory and upgrades. Equipment with different affixes, enchantments, or durability consumes separate types and is better kept in ordinary storage.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.grid_exp: Grid Expansion Warehouses increase Grid Directory capacity. Install them in the directory's upgrade slots; they are not independently placeable blocks.

Each expansion adds 64 item types and 262,144 total items. One directory accepts up to four. Expansions may be removed and moved, but only reduce capacity after the remaining stored contents fit within the smaller limits.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.dimensio: A Dimensional Anchor consumes Source to load its own chunk, and eight Arcane Structural Frames expand it to a 3×3 chunk area.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.sourcebound_copper: The early recipe turns three Copper Ingots, one Gold Ingot, and one Source Gem into two alloys. If Gold Ore cannot be found, the Arcane Reaction Vessel can transmute four Copper Ingots, one Nether Quartz, 250 mB of water, and 400 Source into one Raw Gold.

After completing the mineral line, three Copper Dust, one Gold Dust, one Source Gem, and one each of the Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched Mineral Crystals produce eight alloy dust. Smelting yields eight alloys—four times the early alloy yield from the same metals.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.metal_du: The Arcane Crusher produces metal dusts that can be smelted into their corresponding metals. This mod supplies Iron, Copper, Gold, and Ancient Debris Dust. Crushing raw ores improves metal yield; check the crushing recipes for exact amounts.

In Air Essence mode, each raw mineral produces three dust and each ore block produces two. Water Essence keeps the base yields of two and one while enabling Enriched Mineral Crystal rolls. Ancient Debris produces three Ancient Debris Dust in Air mode. Dusts can be processed into their metals in a furnace or Arcane Smelter; consult Arcane Crusher recipes for exact inputs and yields.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.sourcebo: Sourcebound Copper Alloy is the foundational magical metal used by Arcane Structural Frames, automation devices, and their upgrades. Its early recipe unlocks the Mine and basic infrastructure; completing mineral processing unlocks a much more productive dust route.

The early recipe combines three Copper Ingots, one Gold Ingot, and one Source Gem into two Sourcebound Copper Alloy. After completing the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher, three Copper Dust, one Gold Dust, one Source Gem, and one each of the Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched Mineral Crystals produce eight alloy dust, which smelts into eight alloy. The following pages show both routes.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.starbuncle_hub.upg: All Starbuncles managed by one hub share its throughput. Tiers 0 through 4 move 256, 1,024, 4,096, 16,384, and 32,768 items/s respectively; adding Starbuncles does not increase the hub total. Upgrade it through the Enchanting Apparatus. Filtering, protection, teleport, and recall are fully available at the base tier.

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_r: The Arcane Reaction Vessel processes items with Source and fluids. It is an introductory material-conversion machine available after obtaining the first Source Gem. See the Arcane Reaction JEI category for exact recipes and costs.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_s: The Arcane Source Jar is a pre-Mine 1,000,000-Source buffer that actively gathers nearby Sourcelink output, overcoming the response delay of ordinary jars and relays.

Once per second it gathers from loaded Source producers within 12 blocks: up to 10,000 from each and 50,000 total. Matrix Cores may also push Source into the jar at their own rate, so one fully amplified Matrix can supply about 18,750 Source per second. The jar does not drain machines or other jars, preventing storage loops. Ordinary Ars Nouveau machines may draw from it directly.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_r: The vessel has two item inputs, an item output, a fluid tank, and a Source requirement. Items and fluids may enter or leave from any side. An empty bucket can package 1,000 mB of water, lava, or milk in one second without consuming Source. Filled buckets do not stack, so extract them with a hopper or similar device. See the Arcane Reaction JEI category for exact ingredients, fluid amounts, Source costs, and processing times.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_f: The Arcane Fluid Controller collects, sorts, stores, and wirelessly transports fluids. It includes one fluid tank; installing Arcane Fluid Reservoirs in its dedicated slots lets it manage up to three fluid types.

The menu selects the fluid collected from the world and the default output reservoir. Use a Dominion Wand on the controller then a container to bind output; reverse the order to bind input. The base controller supports one input and one output target. Each Range Upgrade adds one of each, up to four, and all targets share the total transfer speed. Capacity, Range, and Speed use ordinary upgrade slots. Arcane Fluid Reservoirs use separate slots and cannot be removed while nonempty. The controller never creates lava by itself.

The controller has four shared upgrade slots and two reservoir-module slots. Capacity Upgrades increase every unlocked reservoir's capacity. Range Upgrades expand world-fluid searching and raise wireless reach and input/output target limits. Speed Upgrades shorten the work interval and increase the total transfer rate shared by all targets. Installing an empty Arcane Fluid Reservoir unlocks one additional fluid type, up to three at once. The following pages show all three upgrade recipes.
The Arcane Fluid Reservoir is a placeable single-fluid container holding 64,000 mB. It may also be installed as an expansion module inside an Arcane Fluid Controller.

Use a fluid container on the block to insert or withdraw fluid; pipes may access it from any side. Breaking the reservoir preserves its contents, while crafting it by itself clears them. Only an empty reservoir can be installed in a controller, preventing hidden or lost fluid during expansion.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_v: The Arcane Vacuum Hopper directly teleports dropped items and vanilla experience orbs through walls. Its range can be 4, 8, or 12 blocks, or the hopper's entire chunk; larger ranges use longer scan intervals. Redstone pauses collection, conversion, and output.

Use an empty hand to open the menu or sneak-use to deposit all player experience. Created experience gems enter the shared item buffer and use the same Dominion Wand output target as other items; when the buffer is full, experience remains stored and conversion pauses. Filters may be disabled, whitelisted, or blacklisted, and can compare only the item type or also enchantments, durability, and other details. Void Matches is off by default; when enabled, matching collected or inserted items are permanently destroyed. Redstone pauses every function.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_s: The Source Stone Furnace is a fuel-free Wixie automation workstation supporting both smelting and smoking recipes. Each item takes five seconds and pays 20 Source once when processing begins.

The furnace has only input and output slots: ingredients enter from above by default and results leave below. Wixie Pattern Providers recognize it, so multi-step orders that require smelted intermediates can finish automatically. Smelting still waits for the normal processing time.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_vacuum_: The target is not a valid item container
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.stock_re: The Automatic Stock Request Display shares one limit for its monitored target and each automatic request. The base limit is 64; Enchanting Apparatus upgrades raise it to 256, 1,024, and 9,999. Its material progression matches the Wixie order devices, and breaking the block preserves its tier.
tooltip.ars_arcane_matrix.device_tier_de: Right-click an upgradeable device: raise its tier
message.ars_arcane_matrix.device_tier_de: The device tier debug tool can only be used in Creative mode
This block has no adjustable device tier
screen.ars_arcane_matrix.stock_requester: Virtual target: left-click with a carried stack to copy it; right-click to clear
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.advanced: Use an Imbuement Chamber as the apparatus reagent, with two Enchanted Crystals, four Casting Crystals, and two Source Gem Blocks on pedestals. Crafting costs 25,000 Source. It draws up to 2,000 Source per second and prepares in one second; passive progress remains 10 per second.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_p: The tool must be able to mine the ore. Silk Touch tools cannot work. Efficiency reduces processing time, and Fortune improves applicable drops. Ordinary tools lose durability. Ore experience becomes Experience Gems. Ancient Debris bypasses simulated mining and goes directly to the output.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_m: With the Dominion Wand, click the material container then the mine to bind input; reverse the order to bind output. Supply Sourcestone, Source Gems, or Source Gem Blocks and nearby Source. The mine only works when it can pay for a full operation. A complete four-layer mine draws within 32 blocks.
